story_text:
## Translation Shouldn't Interrupt the Conversation.
F1 PRO brings real-time AI translation to face-to-face communication with two 10.1-inch touchscreens, allowing both people to see, speak, and respond from their own side.
No passing phones. No constantly turning screens. Just a more natural way to communicate.
## Language Barriers Shouldn't Break Eye Contact.
You speak.You stop. You look down at your phone. You wait for the translation. You turn the screen around.
The other person reads, replies, and passes it back.
One conversation becomes a series of interruptions.
Traditional translation tools may help translate words, but face-to-face communication is about more than words.
It's about eye contact, natural responses, and keeping both people involved.
## Everything You Need for a Better Conversation.
F1 PRO combines face-to-face translation, intelligent interaction, and business-ready features in one desktop device.
## Why F1 PRO?
More Than Translation. A Better Way to Communicate.
Traditional translation tools help you understand words. F1 PRO is designed to make face-to-face conversations easier, combining dual touchscreens, real-time translation, and AI-powered features in one device.
## The reviews are in
## As See In
## Two Screens Change the Conversation.
No passing a phone back and forth.
F1 PRO places a dedicated 10.1-inch display on each side, so both participants can view the conversation from their own position.
Each IPS display offers a 1280 × 800 resolution and a 16:9 aspect ratio, giving translated content plenty of room to stay readable during a conversation.
## Two-Way Translation, Built for Real Conversations.
Choose the languages for both sides and start talking.
F1 PRO translates speech in both directions, allowing each person to follow the conversation in their preferred language.
Instead of making translation a separate task, F1 PRO brings it directly into the conversation.
## AB Mic Speaker Separation
In a face-to-face conversation, knowing who is speaking matters just as much as recognizing what is being said.
F1 PRO uses its AB microphone configuration to help distinguish speech coming from opposite sides of the device, supporting more organized two-way communication.
## 140+ Languages
From international visitors and overseas customers to business partners from different markets, F1 PRO supports 140+ languages for a wide range of multilingual conversations.
One device. More languages. More opportunities to connect.
## AI Digital Human
F1 PRO goes beyond language translation with AI digital human assistance.
Users can interact with a digital human through the device, ask questions, and receive AI-powered responses.
For businesses, this creates new possibilities for customer introductions, product information, and interactive assistance.
## API Integration
F1 PRO is designed to support API-based integration, creating opportunities to connect AI assistants with business information and services.
From company introductions to product information, businesses can explore more personalized AI interaction experiences.
## AI Meeting Minutes
Important meetings shouldn't end with forgotten details.
F1 PRO supports AI meeting minutes, helping turn recorded meeting content into organized summaries and follow-up items.
Spend more time participating in the conversation and less time manually organizing notes afterward.
## Dual Touchscreen Control
Both displays support 10-point G+G capacitive touch, with touch accuracy specified at ≤1 mm.
F1 PRO combines a large display area with an intuitive interface for everyday use.
## Data & Account Management
F1 PRO is designed with account-based interaction and data management capabilities to support different usage needs.
From daily communication to business applications, organized access to relevant information helps make the experience more convenient.
## Read It. Hear It. Keep Talking.
Translation doesn't have to stay on the screen.
F1 PRO includes 2 × 2W speakers for voice playback, helping both sides follow the conversation through both visual and audio feedback.
## Built for Real-World Conversations
From professional meetings to hospitality and customer-facing environments, F1 PRO is designed to help people communicate across languages.
## Hardware & Connectivity
F1 PRO combines two large touchscreens with a desktop form factor and multiple connectivity options, including USB, USB-C, Ethernet, HDMI, and TF card support.
Built to fit into a range of communication environments.

We will work with suppliers and manufacturing partners to address issues before shipment. API & Third-Party Services API integrations and AI services may depend on external platforms, compatibility requirements, usage policies, or service changes. Shipping & Customs International transportation, customs clearance, local regulations, and unexpected logistics disruptions may affect delivery timing and costs. faq.a: F1 PRO is a dual-screen AI translation device designed for face-to-face multilingual communication.

faq.q: How many screens does F1 PRO have?
faq.a: F1 PRO features two 10.1-inch touchscreens facing opposite sides.

faq.q: Does F1 PRO support two-way translation?
faq.a: Yes. F1 PRO supports real-time two-way voice translation.

faq.q: Can it distinguish between the two speakers?
faq.a: F1 PRO uses a two-channel microphone array and AB microphone processing designed to identify which side is speaking.
Yes. F1 PRO includes built-in speakers for voice playback.
Yes. It supports Wi-Fi and wired Ethernet.

faq.q: Can multiple people use one F1 PRO?
faq.a: The system supports different authorized user accounts, allowing users to switch accounts on the same device.
The companion management system is designed to associate translation records and AI summaries with the active account.
